A '''Station''' was an organizational level of [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], which was part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. Stations were assigned to a [[Market (Corporate Sector Authority)|Market]]. If a Market was spread over multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]], then several [[Enforcement Station]]s were assigned to the area.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
